title: Notes
description: Markdown knowledge base widget — manages a directory of .md files with full-text search, tag graph, and doc-link graph. Includes a Librarian agent for conversational assistance.

doc_root.description: Absolute (or ~-prefixed) path to the notes directory. Also serves as the project root; project.db is created here.

agent.description: Override the Librarian agent config (model, temperature, etc.).
